sourcePolicy: All questions in this pack are Ready2Go original draft practice items unless an individual record states otherwise. No official JAMB past-question corpus is included. Human subject-matter and answer-key review is required before public release.

questions.question: According to the Bible, who led the Israelites out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: The Exodus narrative presents Moses as the leader of the Israelites.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The Ten Commandments are associated with which mountain in the biblical narrative?
questions.explanation: The biblical tradition associates the commandments with Sinai.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Who told the parable of the Good Samaritan?
questions.explanation: Jesus tells the parable in Luke 10.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which apostle is associated with a conversion experience on the road to Damascus?
questions.explanation: Acts describes Saul’s encounter on the road to Damascus.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The Beatitudes appear in which teaching of Jesus?
questions.explanation: The Beatitudes are part of the Sermon on the Mount in Matthew.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Easter celebrates which central Christian belief?

options.A: The crossing of the Jordan by Joshua
options.B: The building of the temple only

questions.explanation: Easter commemorates Jesus’ resurrection.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which book opens the Bible?
questions.explanation: Genesis is the first book of the Bible.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Who defeated Goliath in the biblical account?
questions.explanation: David defeats Goliath in 1 Samuel 17.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Pentecost in Acts is associated with what event?

options.D: The coming of the Holy Spirit upon the disciples

questions.explanation: Acts 2 describes the Holy Spirit coming upon the disciples.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The command to love one’s neighbour emphasises what?

options.C: Care and responsibility toward other people

questions.explanation: The teaching calls for practical concern for others.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which Gospel begins with a genealogy and an infancy narrative emphasising Jesus’ birth?
questions.explanation: Matthew opens with a genealogy and birth narrative.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Who was known as the king who asked God for wisdom?
questions.explanation: Solomon’s request for wisdom is described in 1 Kings 3.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: The Lord’s Prayer is a model of what?
questions.explanation: Jesus teaches the prayer as a model for disciples.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which leader succeeded Moses and led Israel into Canaan in the biblical account?
questions.explanation: Joshua is presented as Moses’ successor.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.

questions.question: Which book describes the journeys and early growth of the Christian church after Jesus’ ascension?
questions.explanation: Acts narrates the early church and missionary journeys.
questions.authoringNote: Original draft created for product testing; requires qualified subject review.
